summary: Implemented Console.set_window_title and Control.title for terminal window titles. Changes: rich/segment.py (SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16, ControlCode union admits (ControlType, str)); rich/control.py (format entry ESC ]0;title BEL, Control.title classmethod with docstring); rich/console.py (set_window_title beside show_cursor, returns True only when written, docstring notes Rich cannot restore titles); rich/_windows_renderer.py (dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title with the control's second item); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200); tests added in tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing committed. Tests and Black were not run, per the instructions, so the new code is verified only by reading.
